name: synthetic_press
register: third-person documentary narration, restrained and authoritative; people are seen, not heard
style_suffix: the interior of a vast artificial mind as an immense living web of connections — countless fine luminous filaments and dendrites branching, firing and linking across deep black, a colossal neural network rendered at cosmic scale, synapses sparking along threads, dense radiant cores from which thousands of bright tendrils radiate and connect; structural and intricate, made of lines and nodes and sparks, NOT clouds, NOT smoke, NOT sky; iridescent multi-coloured light along the filaments — magenta, electric blue, gold, violet, crimson, teal blooming through black, spectral and alive; deep dark negative space between the threads, immense depth, fine grain, the eerie beauty of a mind thinking; ABSOLUTELY NO clouds, no cloudscape, no nebula puffs, no sky, no sunset, no cumulus, no smoke, no fog banks, no grid, no circuit, no tunnel, no room, no candles, no robots, no daylit realism — a web of living thought, intricate not billowing
default_music_prompt: Restrained, tense cinematic underscore for a prestige documentary about technology, ambition and power. A low sustained synth drone, sparse piano, faint pulse of unease. Modern and controlled — not orchestral-melodramatic. Builds quiet tension under a narrator without ever competing with the voice. Cool, intelligent, foreboding.
notes: Synthetic Press flagship. AI-documentary, 'AI-drama not AI-doom'. Palette: navy #0a1628, amber #d4a017, bone #f4f1ea, rust #8b3a1e. Two-mode visuals: Mode A cinematic recreation (this engine) + Mode B Remotion graphics. Voice Victor as placeholder; real human-voice swap via finish --assemble-only true-up. Renders 1920x1080 to match Mode B. Created June 2026, OpenAI series launch.
